Name: (Alternative Textures) Alya's  Furniture Recolor Pack
Author: AlyaLyalya
Description:
[size=3][center]Hello everyone, I have never done pixel art or mods before. I love Stardew Valley and home decorating and made this pack for my personal use. Pixel art (even just recoloring) turned out to be a very interesting and addictive process, i made three sets of furniture at once, lol. And i decided to share this mod with everyone, and hope it will be useful.

You`ll see that some of the furniture are not realistic, but in Stardew you can meet a wizard, witch and other weird creatures, so i think it`s fine :)

Most furniture in this mod are available from the [u]Furniture Catalogue[/u], but there two craftables - [u]chest [/u](50 wood) and [u]mini fridge[/u] (can be purchased at the Carpenter’s Shop for 3,000g), i just wanted more useful furniture that suit the interiors. And there are few other things you can obtain in game process.

***
[u][b]How to use this mod:[/b][/u]
[b]Please note:[/b] It`s a content pack for[b] Alternative Textures[/b] (more detail about [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ mod), so be sure you have AT mod already or download it.
[b]Download this mod.[/b]
[b]Extract it and drop into your mods folder[/b] (you can drop all three sets (folders) or some of them, at your preferences).
[b]In game: [/b]buy the tool [b]“paint bucket”[/b] for 500g from Robin. And use it on things you want to change.
[b]Note: Each folder with furniture set contains text file with List of used items, and an image where you can also see all recolored vanilla items.[/b]

Most recolors are located in one place, it`s makes home decoration easier, e.g., just get “Walnut Bench” and all Bench recolors will be there.

All items in this pack are tagged for in-built search function. Seasons in the Woods tags: [i][u]“Alya”[/u][/i], [i][u]“Woods”[/u][/i], [i][u]“Seasons”[/u][/i] ; Home Garden tags: [i][u]“Alya”[/u][/i], [i][u]“Garden”[/u] [/i]and Burgundy Color tags: [i][u]“Alya”[/u][/i] , [i][u]“Burgundy”[/u][/i].

If there are any bugs, please let me know, I`ll try to solve them (most likely I`ll google their solution, haha), but if there are extra pixels or something wrong with the images, I`ll fix it.

All sprites in this mod are vanilla sprites recolored by me or drawn by me.

[b]Upgrades v.1.1.0:[/b]
Added a few new furniture items: SmallFishTank, ModernFishTank, DeluxeFishTank, LargeFishTank, AquaticSanctuary,  WallSconce, WoodPanel, BurlapRug. One more craftable - Garden Pot. A few variations of Patchwork Rug and one Topiary Tree (Home Garden set). And made some pixel fixes :)
Also added an option to download sets separatelly.

[b]Have fun with decorating![/b][/center][/size]
